Anti Pants Bike Rally

By: Stenette Grosskopf | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
A trouserless Bike Rally in aid of conservation - a colourful event to make a difference

Unique Selling Point:
Skinny van Schalkwyk is a “biker chick”. She grew up with bikes and now in her late 40’s still rides them daily. She loves all things bike, racing around a track, struggling through mud and sand, and even doing bike stunts at events. She also also has a passion to make a positive difference in her community. 5 years ago, she started the yearly “Anti Pants – Anti Poaching” bike ride. This year they will be collecting money for a giraffe sanctuary in Namibia. it's a day of fun, colour and a lot of laughs.

Summary:
Skinny runs a pet crematorium by day and in her free time she enjoys everything "motorbike". From road trips to stunts and everything in between. Skinny decided to give back to the community by starting the Anti Pants Anti Poaching Bike Rally. This year the event will take place on 22 January from Pretoria to Harties. Bikers with a sense of humour are invited to attend, the only requirement is that you ride a motorbike without trousers! Riders showcase everything from tangas to themed boxers in the name of fun and to raise money for wildlife conservation.

Further information:
We would kit Mac out with a bike for the day to join the rally. Mac has been keen to ride motorbikes for some time. We'll spend a day with Skinny before the event, get to know her and even get a peak at her pet crematorium... She will take Mac out and give him some tips on how to handle the bike. She'll show him some stunts (not to be tried at home!) and then we'll join the actual event on the 22 January 2023.

Extra Budget Items:
Travel to Mooinooi, travel to Pta & Harties

Script:



Skinny van Schalkwyk & the Anti Pants Rally

OPENING MONTAGE
V/O Yes… that’s me.. In underwear. On a motorbike. In the middle of Pretoria…
Upsound comment about the Boxers I’m too sexy for my shorts!
V/O But as entertaining as this might be for you, this story is not actually about me … or my boxers…

It’s about the women behind all the silliness – … and the story starts one hot afternoon on a farm just outside Mooinooi in the North West…
UPSOUND Hello… How are you
V/O This is Skinny van Schalkwyk … together with her longtime friend, Jolandi Mentz - known as Chikita - they live and breathe motorbikes!
UPSOUND MAC: So this is the weirdest thing ever, right? Most of the time, when you arrive in people's houses, either by cats or dogs or children. What's going on here? Are these your kids?
Skinny: These are our babies. We have cats as well, but they're not here.
MAC: Do they all have names?
Skinny: Of course yes.
Mac: The one in the front…
Skinny: Billy-Bob the Blue Bike.
MAC: It’s Pink, why is he Billy-Bob the blue bike?
Skinny: In his heart he's blue.
V/O Billy-Bob is the very first motorbike Skinny bought herself, way back in 2004…
Skinny For me it started with the boyfriend that had one and then didn’t think that a woman should ride a bike. So I just went and bought one, why not? In any case, who wants to sit on the back if you can sit on the front?

MAC: Right?
V/O For Skinny it was love at first ride…

She started off track racing, but set her sights on an even bigger challenge…

Skinny I had the superbike, and I decided no… Hmmm stuninting, I haven’t tried that. …
V/O Soon she was performing impressive stunts on a regular basis.
Skinny At one stage I did practice every weekend and sjoe, your game goes up but that’s if you have time and money, because obviously the bikes go through tires and stuff like that. …
V/O Skinny’s love for nature brought her back to the family farm where she built herself a house nestled in the Magaliesberg.
MAC: This for me is the ultimate…
Skinny Skinny: It's got its stories as well. You have to be prepared to live in the vlaktes…

MAC: In the wilderness, Right?

Skinny: Yes, this whole week, we didn't have water. So you have very little water. You have to just brush your teeth. That's it.

MAC: But then you turn around and look at this and you like, it's okay. I can. I can deal with that.

Skinny: Yeah. I think every time, when you think, oh, this life gets too much, just go back to the city.. like, okay, no never, never mind, never mind that.

MAC: And snakes. The snakes you snakes.

Yes. Puff Adder, Mozambique cobra, Egyptian cobra boom slang. We just the other day they had a huge boa. Wow. Huge.

V/O Equally at home in the bush and on a motorbike, it was only a matter of time before Skinny swapped her superbike for an off-road counterpart…
starting a whole new adventurous chapter of her life…
Skinny I had to learn how to ride the dirt bike. And also I also knew if you want to go see the “uithoeke” of South Africa, you're going to have to get on dirt. It's just something you have to do.

V/O And for almost a decade, Skinny and her soft-spoken sidekick, Chikita, have been exploring all corners of southern Africa.
Skinny We often just go on a map and go… Oh, Vlakpan… okay let’s go there.
V/O From Crook’s corner to Sani Pass... These women have seen it all…
Skinny We’re not afraid of dying, we’re not afraid of people or situations. So we do the wild camping thing. Ride until we stop… and camp right there.
V/O
And as you can imagine there are many stories to tell…
but I’m here for one story in particular…
V/O In 2018 Skinny and Chikita came up with a plan to raise awareness and funds for nature conservation…
Skinny We found out that in London they ride, or there’s a day that they ride with the underpants on the train… and we though okay. But then she said, it's a bit strange, the two of us riding through the streets and underpinning pants. You know, people are going to go like, what?
V/O But despite their initial misgivings, they forged ahead and that was the start of the annual Anti Pants-Anti Poaching rally…
A cheeky day of biking without trousers!
V/O And if I want to join them, I’d better get comfy on a motorbike, so it’s time to head down the mountain…
LINK Hopefully Chikita and Skinny are going to teach me how to ride bike… Bucket List…
V/O They make it look so easy as they navigate the winding dirt road down the mountain.

Once the road levels out, it’s my turn….
Skinny It’s very easy. The bike has got.. Make faster… make stop and make lots faster…
V/O It all sounds easy enough!
UPSOUND You go – yay!

You have to put your feet out when you stop!

He’s a natural…



V/O But it will take a lot more than a quick spin on the grass to go from this… to this… even with the prescribed dress code…
Skinny Skinny: It’s only Anti Pants, nê… it’s not anti tops, and anti gloves…

MAC: ‘Cause I was thinking I’m just going in my onderbroek

Skinny: No, no. Please not.

MAC: And is every year a different cause?

Skinny: Yes, the first year we did the rhinos and then we did the pangolins…

MAC: And this year? What’s this year’s one?

Skinny: Giraffes…
V/O And THAT is how I ended up in my designer boxers on that fine Sunday morning…
Skinny Ons is so 200 bikers wat hier bymekaar kom en dan gee hulle maar ‘n donasie en dan ry ons in ons onderbroeke…

We are about 200 bikers gathered here. They give a donation and then we ride in our underpants.
LINK Quite excited, a whole lot of bikers, I met a whole lot of them on the road that are coming for this and I think its a wonderful…

Hello Mac…

That’s not anti-Pants, that’s anti nothing!
V/O You can’t help but smile at some people’s dedication to the cause…
LINK continues So, it’s quite exciting.. I feel a bit overdressed now…
UPSOUND Dis nie ontbloot nie.. Ontbloot is as jy kaalgat is…

It’s not exposed. Exposed is if you’re naked.
UPSOUND Dis vir charity… dis hoekom. So dan’s dit okay…

It’s for charity, that’s why. Then it’s okay.
Skinny Daar’s ‘n paar mense wat hier opdaag sonder ‘n broek. Dis asof daar ‘n groot begeerte is om hulle braafheid te wys… Ek sal dit maar so noem… ja…

There are a few people who arrive without pants. I don’t know… It’s as if there’s a very big urge to prove their “bravery”. I’ll call it that, yes.
UPSOUND Ons kom van die Oosrand af, maar ek het hier langs die pad uitgetrek!

We come from the East Rand, but I undressed on the side of the road.
SONG Gat ons more dorp toe dan sien ons ‘n giraffe
Daar’s kolletjies op su kop.
Daar’s kolletjies op sy nek.
Daar’s kolletjies op sy…
Gat ons more dorp toe dan sien jy ‘n giraffe.

Going to town tomorrow
then we see a giraffe.
There are spots on his head.
There are spots on his neck.
There are spots on his …
Going to town tomorrow
then we see a giraffe.

UPSOUND Cheers to the giraffes!
SKINNY We’re supporting the Giraffe Conservation Foundation. They are in Namibia. And they will support the rest of Africa…
V/O The rally is about to start, but one lesson in a veld somewhere is not quite enough to put me in the rider’s seat of one of these beasts… so I need to make a plan…
ANEMIEN Do you have a helmet?

Do I have one? Got a helmet…
V/O In a flash I am ready for my very first bike rally… with Anemien van der Linde in the driver’s seat…
MAC Where do I hold onto?
V/O Skinny leads the pack through the capitol… to a coffee shop in the northern suburbs for breakfast…
MAC Like a gentleman, when she said hold on.. I’m like… I’m just holding on like this and she said, HOLD ON!

ALRIGHT!
V/O The next leg takes us through the Daspoort tunnel… all the way out to Hartbeespoort…. With a quick halfway stop on a little side road.
Skinny Ons gaan net gou-gou ‘n drone start en dan net ‘n groep foto neem…

We’re just going to quickly start a drone and take a group photo.
MAC I think some people showed a little bit more than just their legs!
V/O The rally ends at a pub just north of the Hartbeespoort Dam… …for a refreshing dip in the pool and an ice cold drink…
Skinny Ahh, a green one… Ja, no, everyone understood that today was about being silly, about being casual.
I am hoofmeisie, so for a hoofmeisie this is amazing. Organising this, having the people here and enjoying the day… I mean wow… what more can you ask for?

MAC: Also, I got my first ever ride, and Anemien was absolutely amazing. And I’m now convinced I’m a biker guy…

Skinny: She told me, she said you’re like a little kid going “I’m getting a bike, I’m getting a bike”
Skinny MAC: So now tell me, what is the future holding for Anti Pants? What’s next?

Well, to me it’s more about raising awareness than anything else… So every year it will grow. We already have 2 or 3 clubs that’s riding around the country, so maybe next year we can make it national…
V/O For now, it's another annual event done and dusted. … The ride home, just long enough to dream up the next, big adventure.

PROMO 1 11” Two biker chicks with a sense of adventure and a love for animals… raising funds for conservation … in their underpants.
PROMO 2 21” From adventure biking across southern Africa …to riding through the streets of Pretoria in UNDERPANTS…

UPS: "We’re not afraid, we’re not afraid of dying, we’re not afraid of people or situations... …”

Skinny and Chikita are living large…

We often just go on a map and go… Oh, Vlakpan… okay let’s go there.

PROMO 3 21”
What … or who… on earth can inspire over 200 bikers to take to the streets in their underpants?


UPS: “it’s for fun”… “conservation”

VO: We meet the women behind the “anti Pants - anti Poaching” campaign…

Ontbloot is as jy kaalgat is… It’s not exposed. Exposed is if you’re naked. UPSOUND Dis vir charity… dis hoekom. So dan’s dit okay… It’s for charity, that’s why. Then it’s okay. Skinny Daar’s ‘n paar mense wat hier opdaag sonder ‘n broek. Dis asof daar ‘n groot begeerte is om hulle braafheid te wys… Ek sal dit maar so noem… ja… There are a few people who arrive without pants. I don’t know… It’s as if there’s a very big urge to prove their “bravery”. I’ll call it that, yes. UPSOUND Ons kom van die Oosrand af, maar ek het hier langs die pad uitgetrek! We come from the East Rand, but I undressed on the side of the road. SONG Gat ons more dorp toe dan sien ons ‘n giraffe Daar’s kolletjies op su kop. Daar’s kolletjies op sy nek. Daar’s kolletjies op sy… Gat ons more dorp toe dan sien jy ‘n giraffe. Going to town tomorrow then we see a giraffe. There are spots on his head. There are spots on his neck. There are spots on his … Going to town tomorrow then we see a giraffe. UPSOUND Cheers to the giraffes! SKINNY We’re supporting the Giraffe Conservation Foundation. They are in Namibia. And they will support the rest of Africa… V/O The rally is about to start, but one lesson in a veld somewhere is not quite enough to put me in the rider’s seat of one of these beasts… so I need to make a plan… ANEMIEN Do you have a helmet? Do I have one? Got a helmet… V/O In a flash I am ready for my very first bike rally… with Anemien van der Linde in the driver’s seat… MAC Where do I hold onto? V/O Skinny leads the pack through the capitol… to a coffee shop in the northern suburbs for breakfast… MAC Like a gentleman, when she said hold on.. I’m like… I’m just holding on like this and she said, HOLD ON! ALRIGHT! V/O The next leg takes us through the Daspoort tunnel… all the way out to Hartbeespoort…. With a quick halfway stop on a little side road. Skinny Ons gaan net gou-gou ‘n drone start en dan net ‘n groep foto neem… We’re just going to quickly start a drone and take a group photo. MAC I think some people showed a little bit more than just their legs! V/O The rally ends at a pub just north of the Hartbeespoort Dam… …for a refreshing dip in the pool and an ice cold drink… Skinny Ahh, a green one… Ja, no, everyone understood that today was about being silly, about being casual. I am hoofmeisie, so for a hoofmeisie this is amazing. Organising this, having the people here and enjoying the day… I mean wow… what more can you ask for? MAC: Also, I got my first ever ride, and Anemien was absolutely amazing. And I’m now convinced I’m a biker guy… Skinny: She told me, she said you’re like a little kid going “I’m getting a bike, I’m getting a bike” Skinny MAC: So now tell me, what is the future holding for Anti Pants? We already have 2 or 3 clubs that’s riding around the country, so maybe next year we can make it national… V/O For now, it's another annual event done and dusted. … The ride home, just long enough to dream up the next, big adventure. PROMO 1 11” Two biker chicks with a sense of adventure and a love for animals… raising funds for conservation … in their underpants. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): A trouserless Bike Rally in aid of conservation - a colourful event to make a difference
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Skinny van Schalkwyk is a “biker chick”. She grew up with bikes and now in her late 40’s still rides them daily. She loves all things bike, racing around a track, struggling through mud and sand, and even doing bike stunts at events. She also also has a passion to make a positive difference in her community. 5 years ago, she started the yearly “Anti Pants – Anti Poaching” bike ride. This year they will be collecting money for a giraffe sanctuary in Namibia. it's a day of fun, colour and a lot of laughs.
metadata.Summary: Skinny runs a pet crematorium by day and in her free time she enjoys everything "motorbike". From road trips to stunts and everything in between. Skinny decided to give back to the community by starting the Anti Pants Anti Poaching Bike Rally. This year the event will take place on 22 January from Pretoria to Harties. Bikers with a sense of humour are invited to attend, the only requirement is that you ride a motorbike without trousers! Riders showcase everything from tangas to themed boxers in the name of fun and to raise money for wildlife conservation.
metadata.Further information: We would kit Mac out with a bike for the day to join the rally. Mac has been keen to ride motorbikes for some time. We'll spend a day with Skinny before the event, get to know her and even get a peak at her pet crematorium... She will take Mac out and give him some tips on how to handle the bike. She'll show him some stunts (not to be tried at home!) and then we'll join the actual event on the 22 January 2023.
